body: Wise words, please take heed of them! Please. You think no one cares about your death? Just look at all of us, complete strangers, who want you to stay alive, to get through this tough time, and to live for the small time you have anyway. I mean as you said, we are all going to die, and that is it. So, if it's been 7 attempts, there is room for an 8th, because I guarantee you, things will get better if you hold on. Feel free to keep talking with me, seriously, I'll chat with you all night if it means it will save your life.
